members.name: value
members.doc: The area's color, when the caller controls it. The area edits its saturation and brightness and keeps the hue.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting color, when the area controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time saturation or brightness changes, in the color space of the value, of the enclosing ColorPicker, or of defaultValue, and in rgba() form with none of them. A disabled or read-only area does not call it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the area: it can be neither focused nor changed. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the area read-only: it stays focusable but its color cannot be changed. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

types.name: ColorAreaOwnProps

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the area. Without one, the area needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.
